body.p: A needle disposal container includes a container body and a covering attached to the container body. The covering includes a lid body that covers the open top of the container body and a movable member movable relative to the lid body between a hold position and a retract position. The lid body is formed with a first wall having a first surface, and the movable member is formed with a second wall having a second surface. The first surface and the second surface together form a cylindrical surface that defines an insertion opening. The cylindrical surface is formed with a first rotation- preventer that prevents rotation of a first needle unit inserted into the insertion opening and a second rotation-preventer that prevents rotation of a second needle unit inserted into the insertion opening. The second needle unit has a second needle hub with a smaller diameter than a diameter of a first needle hub of the first needle unit.
